title: Figures 13-14: max velocity vs fuel usage; acceleration and rocket clock ratio vs time
description: Two line graphs on green grids. Figure 13, "Maximum Achievable Velocity Versus Fuel Usage," plots maximum velocity / speed of light against mass of fuel consumed / total initial rocket mass, with a red curve rising steeply near 1. Figure 14, "Acceleration and Rocket 'Clock' Ratio versus Mission Time on Earth," plots acceleration / Earth's gravitational acceleration (red) and time (rocket)/time (Earth) (blue dotted) against time in years (0–50) in the Earth reference frame. Part of a relativistic rocket analysis for interstellar missions.
